svg.title: Room 3, eleven o'clock, from the back
svg.desc: A language classroom seen from the back. Eleven students sit at desks with a screen at every desk or in every hand, while the teacher writes at the board with her back turned. One phone is face down, one is charging from the wall, and one is showing a map.

g.text: Room 3, eleven o'clock, from the back
Fourteen things to find. Four of the eleven screens are showing the same thing.
the roof - a cable comes in here
room 7 - empty, and the wifi is better
Escola Monte, the back wall of room 3
the window - the street, and nobody looking at it
Yusuf - a message, not a word
Lin - a map, and she knows the way
Emre - the screen is face down
the box the school wants to put by the door
the noticeboard - nobody reads it either
Teresa - at the board, facing away
